decisions.statement: Each dimension is a multiple of sixteen inside the range the service takes.
A service that is no image-generation pool member is refused.
The model is the model path the service's command binds.
A seed nothing named is drawn.
A seed is recorded whether that seed was drawn or said.
The guidance is recorded on the run row.
The image is written where the caller named that image and nowhere else.
Nothing here makes the service resident.

definition: the command rendering one image off a prompt through an image pool service
